error[ZBX-E0702]: can't write the bundle
  while  saving the bundle
  cause  writing the bundle failed: no space left on the device (ENOSPC)
  path   /home/alice/.local/state/zbx/bundles/2026-10-24T20-23-04Z-web-1.tar.gz
  fix    free space on that disk, or use another:   export XDG_STATE_HOME=/path/with/room
